verdict.rationale: Netlify is a proprietary, fully-managed hosting/deploy platform; no evidence of an open-source self-hostable core or self-hosting instructions exists in the evidence pack, and one community comment even frames Netlify as the alternative to self-hosting. This is an applicable axis (many dev-tool platforms could offer OSS self-hosted editions) but no evidence supports it, so it is 'none' not 'na'.
